site.name: Reviewkit
site.tagline: Show your Trustpilot reviews on WordPress. No API keys, no code, no slowdowns.

plans.name: Free
features: Sort and filter by star rating

faqs.q: Do I need a Trustpilot account?
faqs.a: Yes. You need a Trustpilot business profile with reviews. Paste its link into Reviewkit and you are connected.

faqs.q: Do I need an API key or developer?
faqs.a: No. Setup is pasting your Trustpilot link and clicking Sync Reviews.

faqs.q: Will it slow down my site?
faqs.a: No. Reviews are stored on your site and styles load only on pages that show a widget.

faqs.q: Can I try Pro before buying?
faqs.a: Start with the free plugin, which already shows your reviews. Add Pro when you want more control. Refunds follow the policy shown at checkout.

faqs.q: What happens when my license ends?
faqs.a: Your reviews keep displaying with the free plugin. Pro features and updates pause until you renew.
No. Reviewkit is independent and only shows publicly available review data.

items: Added function prefixes to all plugin functions to avoid global naming conflicts
Introduced Automatic Sync, using wp-cron for scheduled review updates
Added options to purge cached data for improved flexibility
Made syncing reviews easier: one Sync Reviews button instead of Fetch Reviews and Sync Reviews
A few minor bug fixes and improvements
Initial release with 7 Trustpilot business widgets

features.d: Design a review widget by clicking, not coding. Pick a layout, set your filters, and save it.
Build once, use everywhere. Each widget gets its own shortcode, so one edit updates every page.
Set a minimum star rating, choose the order, and trim long reviews to a length you like.
Hide review dates and keep cards focused on what customers said.
Control speed, autoplay, looping and slides per screen on desktop, tablet and mobile.
